subject: Week 43: toddler immersion tour window opens — book before May 11

content.hook: The toddler-entry immersion tour window opens this week and runs to the birthday. If Mandarin immersion is on the table, the tour goes on the calendar this month — before birthday logistics crowd it out.
content.thisWeek: Days 299–305 are motor-consolidation days: cruising smooths out, walking with hands held is common, and standing alone momentarily is emerging for some (CDC checkpoint: 12 months — https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/1-year.html). Cognitively he is hiding toys on purpose to recover them, and vocalizations now carry adult-like intonation; first specific words are emerging for some, with the CDC 2022 checkpoint for words beyond mama/dada at 15 months. Early attainment on any of these is a bonus, not the baseline.
watchFors: [low concern] Sleep fragmentation around the mobility surge — new motor skills reliably disrupt sleep for a week or two.
[monitor] The combination of no words, no babble, and no joint attention — document specific examples now so the 12-month-visit conversation is concrete.
[call within 24h] Illness persisting past three days, or a fever that returns after a clear day.
[call now] Fever ≥102°F rectal with lethargy, labored breathing, or blue lips or unresponsiveness — 911.

enrichment.body: Tour L'Academy Nob Hill this month: Mandarin immersion with Spanish enrichment from 12 months, ELFA subsidies accepted, tour-to-start lead time 1–3 months with waitlists at popular rooms — touring before the birthday sets up a month-12–13 start. Calendar Little Bee and Fun With Mandarin (both 18-month minimums) for the month-15–18 review. Live immersion is the exposure mode with high-grade evidence; the dose target is 25–30% of waking hours.
Build a cruising circuit — couch to coffee table to ottoman with 6–12-inch gaps — and let him bridge the gaps himself; unassisted bridging is the precursor to momentary standing.
Hide a toy under one of two cups and swap their positions slowly — deliberate search is this week's cognitive work, and the two-cup version scales the difficulty as he gets faster.
Hold read-aloud at 30 minutes a day cumulative, split across three or four sittings; dialogic style — point, ask, expand — is what carries the vocabulary effect.

upcoming: Day 300–365 (Mar 7–May 11, 2027): toddler-immersion tour window open — a tour booked before the birthday beats touring after it.
Day 365 (Tue May 11, 2027): first birthday — pick the format now (family-only, mid-size, or venue); SF photographers for a May date book 2–4 months out, so that decision lands next week.

subject: Week 44: book the birthday photographer — SF lead times run 2-4 months

content.hook: First-birthday planning goes live this week, and the photographer is the long-lead item: SF photographers book 2–4 months out, which makes this the decision week for a May 11 date.
content.thisWeek: Days 306–312: walking is the dominant motor question — emerging for some, with standing alone momentarily at the CDC 12-month checkpoint — and falls are part of the practice loop. He is imitating familiar actions, using objects intentionally, and understands "no" (CDC 12-month); first specific words remain emerging for some, with the CDC 2022 checkpoint for words beyond mama/dada at 15 months.
watchFors: [low concern] Falls during walking practice — forehead and shin bruises are the tuition for the skill.
[monitor] No interest in interactive games (peekaboo, give-and-take) plus no babble — a two-domain absence is worth a written note for the visit list.
[call within 24h] New ear-infection signs — night waking with crying plus ear-pulling after congestion — or any illness that will not resolve.
[call now] Head injury with vomiting, lethargy, or unequal pupils; fever ≥102°F rectal with lethargy; labored breathing — 911.

enrichment.body: Book the first-birthday photographer this week: candid-documentary style beats posed for one-year-olds, sessions run $400–1,500 for 60–90 minutes, and 2–4-month lead times make this the last comfortable week for May 11. Book a separate 15-minute everyone-in-frame slot — the cake photos crowd out the family photo otherwise.
Play imitation games in both directions — copy his spoon-banging, then offer clap, wave, and stack-and-knock for him to copy back; imitation is the social-learning channel year 2 runs on.

Set up in-and-out play: one wide container plus fist-sized safe objects — putting a block in a cup is a CDC 12-month checkpoint, and he will run the fill-and-dump loop for surprisingly long stretches.
Tape butcher paper to the floor and hand over one jumbo crayon — expect mouthing and a few accidental marks; this is grip and cause-and-effect practice, not art.

upcoming: Day 365 (Tue May 11, 2027): first birthday — photographer confirmed this week; guest list and format locked by end of March.
Day 344–351 (Apr 20–27, 2027): custom cake and smash-cake order window (2–3-week bakery lead) — calendar it now, and decide smash cake versus stacked-fruit alternative before ordering.

subject: Week 45: respond to every point — gestures are the pre-word signal

content.hook: Pointing is this month's highest-value language signal. Every point he makes is an invitation for a labeling turn, and the respond-name-expand loop is the mechanism with the strongest evidence behind it.
content.thisWeek: Days 313–319: cruising for many, first independent steps for early walkers — the range for first steps runs roughly 9 to 15+ months, with the CDC walks-alone checkpoint at 15 months (https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/15-months.html). Comprehension is running well ahead of speech: he searches for fully hidden objects, uses objects functionally, and shows the full emotional range; first words are emerging for some, with the CDC 2022 checkpoint for words beyond mama/dada at 15 months.
watchFors: [low concern] Clinginess and pickier eating — a toddler-style behavior dip that passes on its own.
[monitor] Sustained milestone absence across multiple domains at once (motor plus language plus social); single-domain lag on its own is usually timing variance.
[call within 24h] Persistent illness, or reduced intake with noticeably fewer wet diapers.
[call now] Severe respiratory distress — retractions, grunting, blue lips — or fever ≥102°F rectal with lethargy — 911.

enrichment.body: Respond to every point with a three-beat loop — follow the point, name the thing, expand by one attribute (dog; big brown dog). Conversational turns, not raw word count, drive the language-network effect.

Clear a barefoot walking runway — 8–10 feet of clutter-free floor between two stable anchors — and let him launch on his own; hands-free practice beats hand-walking for balance learning, whether first steps come this month or at 15 months.
Start the year-1 photo book now rather than birthday week — Artifact Uprising, Mixbook, and Chatbooks all handle 12-month layouts; an hour a week from here finishes it without a deadline scramble.
Shift part of read-aloud time to point-and-name board books and let him drive the page turns — following his attention is what dialogic reading looks like at this age.

upcoming: Day 344–351 (Apr 20–27, 2027): cake-order window — custom bakeries want 2–3 weeks of lead for a May 11 pickup.
Day 365 (Tue May 11, 2027): first birthday — RSVPs out this week if they are not already; schedule the party for late morning or after the second nap, and protect both naps on the day.

subject: Week 46: book the 12-month well visit — May 10-26, five vaccines due

content.hook: Book the 12-month well visit now — the May 10–26 window is the biggest visit of year 1: five vaccines, hemoglobin, lead screen, and first dental guidance. This is also the week to start the bottle-weaning sequence.
content.thisWeek: Days 320–326: standing alone momentarily for many (CDC checkpoint: 12 months) and a few unassisted steps for some — the walks-alone checkpoint sits at 15 months. Language is where the 12-month checkpoint gets specific: mama and dada aimed at the right parent count as first words, while words beyond that sit at the 15-month checkpoint, so their absence now is expected rather than a flag. Tool use is emerging — he will drag a string to reach the toy tied to the end of it.
watchFors: [low concern] Day-to-day appetite swings of 40% in either direction — intake averages out over the week at this age.
[monitor] No babble and no words at all as the visit approaches — top of the question list, in writing.
[monitor] During bottle weaning: refusal of all milk substitutes for more than a few days, or a flat weight trend.
[call within 24h] New wheezing, or any illness persisting past three days.
[call now] Labored breathing with retractions, fever ≥102°F rectal with lethargy, or unresponsiveness — 911.

enrichment.body: Start the bottle-weaning sequence — replace one daytime bottle per week with a meal plus an open or straw cup, saving the pre-bed bottle for last; AAP guidance is off the bottle by 12–18 months, and the documented costs of running long are iron deficiency and dental caries.
Log what mama and dada currently mean — use directed at the right parent is the CDC 12-month language checkpoint, and a week of notes gives the pediatrician better data than recall at the visit.
Engineer momentary standing: stand him at the couch and hand him a toy that needs both hands — the let-go moment is the checkpoint behavior, and he finds it on his own when his hands are busy.
Practice give-and-take — ask for the block, thank him, hand it back; giving an object on request is a 12-month social behavior and doubles as early turn-taking.

upcoming: Day 364–380 (May 10–26, 2027): 12-month well visit — book now. Vaccines: MMR #1, VAR #1, HepA #1, PCV #4, Hib booster; plus hemoglobin, lead screen, and first dental guidance. Mild fever or rash 7–12 days after MMR/VAR is common and not contagious.
Day 365 (Tue May 11, 2027): first birthday — final headcount and day-of timeline over the next two weeks.

subject: Week 47: start the whole-milk and bottle-weaning transition plan

content.hook: Start the whole-milk transition plan: at 12 months formula ends, milk drops to 16–24 oz a day in a cup, and table food carries the calories. A four-week runway makes the switch a non-event.
content.thisWeek: Days 327–333: cruising for many and independent steps for some — the CDC walks-alone checkpoint remains 15 months, so pre-birthday walking is a bonus, not the bar. Object permanence is solid, cause-and-effect play is getting deliberate, and gestural communication is rich: pointing, showing, giving, waving. Socially expect warm-with-familiar, wary-with-strangers — which matters for party planning with relatives he sees rarely.
watchFors: [low concern] Sleep disruption while visiting family cycles through — hold nap times and the bedtime routine where you can.
[low concern] Stranger wariness with rarely-seen relatives — normal 10–12-month behavior, not rudeness and not regression.
[monitor] Sleep regression lasting more than two weeks — bring it to the 12-month visit rather than waiting it out further.
[call within 24h] Persistent illness in the run-up to party week — resolve it now, not the Friday before.
[call now] Severe respiratory distress, fever ≥102°F rectal with lethargy, or blue lips or unresponsiveness — 911.

enrichment.body: Plan the whole-milk switch: whole cow's milk (not reduced-fat, no toddler formula needed) from 12 months at 16–24 oz per day — more than that crowds out iron-rich food, which is why the 12-month visit checks hemoglobin. Start offering an ounce or two in an open cup at meals now; acceptance often takes 10+ exposures.
Build a cause-and-effect station — pop-up box, ball ramp, drop-a-block chute — and let him run repetitions; deliberate cause-and-effect testing is the cognitive work of this stretch.
Trade some cruising furniture time for a weighted push toy on flat ground — supported stepping at self-controlled speed, useful whether he walks next week or at 14 months.
Run a daily photo review of party guests — name each relative aloud while he looks; familiar-face pre-loading softens day-of stranger wariness and doubles as labeling practice.

upcoming: Day 344–351 (Apr 20–27, 2027): cake and smash-cake order window — custom bakeries want 2–3 weeks of lead for May 11; decide smash cake versus stacked-fruit alternative before ordering.
Day 364–380 (May 10–26, 2027): 12-month well visit — confirm the booking and start the written question list: sleep, eating range, walking, weaning progress.
Day 300–365 (Mar 7–May 11, 2027): immersion tour window closes at the birthday — if the L'Academy Nob Hill tour is still unbooked, book it this week.
